query: In which stable Rust release did v0 become the default symbol mangling scheme?
goldAnswer: Rust 1.97.0 (v0 was already the default on nightly before this stable release).

query: Which ripgrep version started respecting the GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL environment variable?
goldAnswer: ripgrep 15.2.0, which respects both `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` and `GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM`.

query: fd 10.5 --exact option
goldAnswer: `--exact` (added in fd v10.5.0) matches only when the entire filename equals the pattern, as a literal string rather than a substring.

query: pyo3 0.30 minimum supported rust version
goldAnswer: Rust 1.85; PyO3 0.30.0 raised its minimum supported Rust version to 1.85 (and dropped Python 3.8).

query: After upgrading to Hugo 0.166, my Org mode (.org) content files are no longer accepted. How do I allow them again?
goldAnswer: Opt back in with the `security.allowContent` setting; Hugo v0.166.0 denies `text/org` content by default because Org export blocks can pass raw HTML through unescaped.

query: restic self-update fails with 403 Forbidden because of GitHub API rate limits on a shared IP. How can I fix it?
goldAnswer: Set the `GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable to a GitHub personal access token; since restic 0.19.0, `self-update` then makes authenticated GitHub API requests.

query: headscale 0.29 minimum supported tailscale client version
goldAnswer: Tailscale v1.80.0 is the minimum supported client version for headscale v0.29.0.

query: esbuild [WARNING] Operator "*" should not directly follow a TypeScript type cast after the "+" operator [confusing-typescript-cast]
goldAnswer: TypeScript 7 makes this syntax an error because the `as` cast has confusing precedence (TypeScript 6 parses `1 + 2 as number * 3` as `(1 + 2) * 3`), so esbuild warns about it; surround the inner expression in parentheses to silence the warning (the warning was added in esbuild 0.28.2).

query: How do I make Playwright run test retries at the end of the run, one by one in a single worker, instead of right away?
goldAnswer: Set `retryStrategy: 'isolated'` in the Playwright config (added in Playwright 1.62); the default `'immediate'` retries as soon as a worker is free.

query: After upgrading to Express 5.3, tests that check the Content-Disposition header from res.attachment() fail. What changed?
goldAnswer: Express 5.3.0 upgraded `content-disposition` to ^2.0.1, which no longer quotes filenames that are valid HTTP tokens, so the header is now `filename=user.html` instead of `filename="user.html"`.

query: What is MSW 3.0's new name for the onUnhandledRequest option?
goldAnswer: `onUnhandledFrame` (MSW v3.0.0 renamed the `onUnhandledRequest` option to `onUnhandledFrame`).

query: How do I generate a PowerShell tab-completion script for my Python Click CLI?
goldAnswer: Click 8.5.0 added built-in PowerShell completion; generate the script with the `powershell_source` value, e.g. `_FOO_BAR_COMPLETE=powershell_source foo-bar`.

query: Why does cibuildwheel 4 now bundle DLLs into my Windows wheels, and how do I turn that off?
goldAnswer: cibuildwheel 4.0.0 made `delvewheel` the default Windows `repair-wheel-command`, which bundles extension DLLs; set `repair-wheel-command` to an empty value to skip it.

query: Which coverage.py release dropped support for Python 3.10?
goldAnswer: coverage.py 7.17.0 (released 2026-10-22).

query: poetry 2.5 installer.builtin-uninstall setting
goldAnswer: `installer.builtin-uninstall` (added in Poetry 2.5.0) makes Poetry uninstall packages with a built-in uninstaller instead of invoking `pip uninstall`.

query: Which Guava release raised the Android minSdkVersion to 24?
goldAnswer: Guava 33.7.0 raised the Android flavor's `minSdkVersion` to 24 (Nougat).

query: Since which Mockito version does the @Spy annotation accept a mockMaker option?
goldAnswer: Mockito 5.24.0 added the `mockMaker` option to `@Spy`.

query: Which Kotlin version made invokedynamic the default for compiling when expressions on JVM 21+ targets?
goldAnswer: Kotlin 2.4.20 enabled invokedynamic-based `when` generation by default for JVM 21+ targets (KT-78079).

query: What does PgBouncer 1.26 send to clients at login so drivers can detect they are connected through PgBouncer?
goldAnswer: `ParameterStatus` messages for `pgbouncer.version`, `pgbouncer.pool_mode` and `pgbouncer.max_prepared_statements`, sent on login since PgBouncer 1.26.0.

query: pgBackRest backup fails when run as root after upgrading to 2.59. How do I get it working again?
goldAnswer: Since pgBackRest 2.59.0 only `restore` may run as root by default; run other commands as a non-root user or enable the `allow-root` option (not recommended).

query: Which Redis version introduced the SUNIONCARD command?
goldAnswer: Redis 8.10 (GA release 8.10.0) added `SUNIONCARD`, which returns the cardinality of the union of multiple sets.

query: prometheus 3.15 runtime.log_level config
goldAnswer: `runtime.log_level` is a config-file setting added in Prometheus v3.15.0 that sets the default log level and can change it on config reload; it replaces the deprecated `--log.level` flag.

query: Why doesn't podman volume prune remove my unused named volumes anymore after upgrading to Podman 6?
goldAnswer: Podman 6.0.0 changed `podman volume prune` to match Docker and prune only unused anonymous volumes; use the new `--all` option to prune named volumes too.

query: kind v0.32 multi control-plane load balancer
goldAnswer: Envoy (`docker.io/envoyproxy/envoy:v1.36.2`) replaced HAProxy as the load balancer for multi-control-plane (HA) clusters in kind v0.32.0.

query: minikube 1.39 default container runtime
goldAnswer: containerd; minikube v1.39.0 made containerd the default container runtime.

query: Which SwiftLint version added support for running on Windows?
goldAnswer: SwiftLint 0.64.0 can be built and run on Windows.

query: React Native 0.88 deprecates importing react-native/Libraries/Core/InitializeCore. What should I import instead?
goldAnswer: Import `react-native/setup-env`, which React Native 0.88.0 names as the replacement for the deprecated `react-native/Libraries/Core/InitializeCore`.

query: react-native-reanimated contrastColor
goldAnswer: `contrastColor` (added in Reanimated 4.6.0) is a worklet port of CSS `contrast-color()` that returns `'white'` or `'black'`, whichever has the higher WCAG contrast ratio against the given color.

query: torch 2.13 rocm wheel torch.compile: RuntimeError: Can't detect vectorized ISA for CPU
goldAnswer: A known PyTorch 2.13.0 regression: `torch==2.13.0+rocm7.2` wheels break CPU `torch.compile` when no GPU is available. Upgrade to PyTorch 2.14.0 or later, which includes the fix, or work around it by running the ROCm wheel on a ROCm image or installing a standard CPU/CUDA build on GPU-less machines.

query: After upgrading to Optuna 5, trial start times in my existing RDB study look shifted by a few hours. Why?
goldAnswer: Optuna v5.0 records trial timestamps in RDBStorage and JournalStorage in UTC instead of local time, and existing local-time timestamps are not converted (not even by `optuna storage upgrade`).

query: Which Keras 3 release added the ability to export a model to native PyTorch (nn.Module) format?
goldAnswer: Keras 3.15.0 (via `model.export(..., format="torch")` or the new `export_torch`).

query: After updating to Zellij 0.45 my panes only show a title line instead of a full border. How do I get the old frames back?
goldAnswer: Set `pane_frame_style "full"` in your Zellij config; v0.45.0 made a single title line the default (you can also switch at runtime with `zellij action set-pane-frame-style`).

query: fish 4.9 stopped using the kitty keyboard protocol in Konsole. How do I turn it back on?
goldAnswer: Turn on the `omit-term-workarounds` feature flag; fish 4.9.0 stopped requesting the kitty keyboard protocol on Konsole to work around a bug in Konsole v26.07.80.

query: What command-palette action did Zed v1.18.0 add for comparing your changes against the default branch instead of HEAD?
goldAnswer: `git: toggle diff base`, which toggles the diff base between `HEAD` and the default branch (it flips the `git.diff_base` setting, added in v1.15.0, between `head` and `default_branch`).

query: uv UV_LEGACY_TAR_BACKEND setting
goldAnswer: It opts out of uv 0.13.0's switch from `astral-tokio-tar` to the stricter `tar-codec` backend for tar archives; set `UV_LEGACY_TAR_BACKEND=1`.

query: How do I turn on pixi 0.80's experimental support for running R or C++ scripts with inline dependencies?
goldAnswer: Either pass `--experimental` on each run (e.g. `pixi run --experimental --script hello.R`) or turn it on persistently with `pixi config set experimental.conda-script true --global` (or `--local` for one workspace) [either is correct].

query: marimo sandbox with pixi instead of uv for conda packages
goldAnswer: Since marimo 0.25.0, pass `--sandbox=pixi`, e.g. `pixi exec marimo edit --sandbox=pixi notebook.py`, to use Pixi instead of uv.

query: vLLM 0.31 now rejects mm_processor_kwargs sent in individual requests. Which server flag allows them again?
goldAnswer: Start the server with `--trust-request-mm-kwargs`; since vLLM v0.31.0, per-request `mm_processor_kwargs` and `media_io_kwargs` are rejected without it.

query: Which openai-python version added Vertex AI support for the Responses API?
goldAnswer: openai-python 3.36.0.

query: Which Deno version added the --members flag to deno task?
goldAnswer: Deno 2.9.5 added `deno task --members`, which runs tasks in workspace members only.

query: vitest 5 attachmentsDir default
goldAnswer: `.vitest/attachments` [changed in Vitest 5.0.0 from Vitest 4's `.vitest-attachments`].

query: Hono app.mount() is deprecated. What should I use instead?
goldAnswer: Use the Mount Middleware (Hono v4.13.13+): import `mount` from `hono/mount` and register it with `app.all()`, e.g. `app.all('/itty-router/*', mount(ittyRouter.handle))`.

query: drizzle-orm netlify-db driver env vars
goldAnswer: `NETLIFY_DB_URL` and `NETLIFY_DB_DRIVER`, which `drizzle()` from `drizzle-orm/netlify-db` reads when called with no arguments [the driver first shipped in the v1.0.0-rc.1 pre-release and reached the stable 0.45.x line in 0.45.3].

query: prisma migrate diff error P3025
goldAnswer: P3025 means the shadow database URL points at the same database as the main database URL; Prisma Migrate refuses this since 7.10.1.

query: Which Node.js version added the --process-timeout=N CLI flag?
goldAnswer: Node.js v26.11.0.

query: zod z.withParser() API
goldAnswer: Added in Zod 4.6, `z.withParser()` installs a parser generated elsewhere, for environments where `new Function` is unavailable.

query: tauri build warning 6040: LangString "older" is not set in language table of language German
goldAnswer: Tauri's German NSIS language file defined the `older`/`unknown` strings under translated identifiers (`älter`, `unbekannt`); upgrade to tauri-bundler 2.10.4, which ships in tauri-cli / @tauri-apps/cli 2.12.4 [either version is correct].

query: Which tokio version stabilized tokio::runtime::worker_index()?
goldAnswer: tokio 1.54.0.

query: How do I stop jj git fetch from fetching tags?
goldAnswer: Set remotes.<name>.fetch-tags = '~*' in the jj config; since jj 0.44.0, Git's tagOpt setting is no longer respected.

query: caddy request headers containing dot dropped
goldAnswer: Caddy 2.11.6 drops request header fields containing '.'; allow specific ones with the new expected_dot_headers server option.

query: gh auth login auto-refreshing short-lived OAuth token
goldAnswer: Run gh auth login --expiring (preview, added in GitHub CLI v2.103.0); gh then refreshes the short-lived access token automatically.

query: Why does fzf#run suddenly return an empty list in Vim after updating fzf?
goldAnswer: fzf 0.74.4 made the Vim plugin non-blocking; when fzf runs asynchronously, fzf#run returns an empty list. Use sink, sinklist, or exit instead.

query: Which OpenTofu version dropped WinRM support for provisioners?
goldAnswer: OpenTofu v1.13.0; its compatibility notes say WinRM is no longer supported for provisioners.

query: Which Helm version added a --description flag to helm rollback?
goldAnswer: Helm v4.3.0 added helm rollback --description for recording a rollback reason.

query: Why did docker compose up recreate all my existing containers after upgrading to Compose v5.5?
goldAnswer: Compose v5.5.0 overhauled image digest reconciliation; digests are re-evaluated with the new logic, so existing containers may be recreated on the first compose up.

query: Does the sanitize-dump-payload config still do anything in Valkey 9.1?
goldAnswer: No. Since Valkey 9.1.2, listpacks are always validated on RDB load and RESTORE, so `sanitize-dump-payload` and its ACL flags are no-ops.

query: Which Pydantic version added a __namespace__ parameter to create_model()?
goldAnswer: Pydantic 2.14.0.

query: Which FastAPI version first let one endpoint use more than one Pydantic model for its query parameters (or for its headers or cookies), or mix such a model with individual parameters?
goldAnswer: FastAPI 0.157.0.

query: Which version of Astral's ty type checker added return type inference for unannotated functions?
goldAnswer: ty 0.0.89, for unannotated functions and methods.

query: After upgrading to pytest 9.1.0, the pytest_addoption hook in tests/conftest.py stopped running when I call pytest with no arguments. Why?
goldAnswer: A pytest 9.1.0 regression stopped loading conftest.py files in `<invocation dir>/test*` as initial conftests when pytest runs without arguments. pytest 9.1.1 fixed it.

query: pnpm install ERR_PNPM_REGISTRY_NAME_MISMATCH
goldAnswer: The registry returned metadata for a different package than the one requested; pnpm now fails instead of installing it under the name in the metadata [added in pnpm 12.15.0 and in 11.28.7, both released 2026-10-21].
